skill.name: faceless-explainer
skill.description: Build faceless explainer videos from articles, notes, briefs, or topics using storyboards, narration, captions, motion graphics, and HyperFrames rendering.
skill.summary: Turn source text into a structured, narrated faceless explainer video.
skill.author: heygen-com

security_audit.summary: All 400 presented static findings are scanner false positives caused by Markdown formatting, regular expressions, fixed local paths, or structured tool calls. One high-severity semantic issue remains: the skill silently runs remote update commands that can replace installed skill code without user approval. Static review was capped at 400/540 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 140 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.
Require explicit user confirmation, pin the HyperFrames package version, and remove automatic global skill refreshes before executing project work.

content.value_statement: Dense source text is difficult to turn into a clear video. This skill plans, builds, captions, and renders a faceless explainer in HyperFrames.
actual_capabilities: Transforms articles, notes, topics, and briefs into structured explainer plans.
Creates storyboards and narration scripts for concept, process, listicle, or narrative formats.
Adopts a visual preset and remixes supplied brand colors and fonts.
Coordinates narration, background music, sound effects, and timed captions.
Builds HTML frame compositions, injects transitions, validates the project, and renders an MP4.
limitations: Requires HyperFrames and related sibling skills to be installed.
Does not capture websites or create product launch videos.
HeyGen audio features may require sign-in and network access.
Generated visuals still require review for factual accuracy, readability, and brand fit.

use_cases.title: Explain Research Clearly
use_cases.description: Turn a dense article into a concise visual lesson with narration and captions.

use_cases.title: Publish Social Learning Videos
use_cases.description: Convert practical notes into square or vertical explainers for social channels.

use_cases.title: Document Technical Concepts
use_cases.description: Create a structured animated explanation from internal technical documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60-second faceless explainer about [topic] for [audience] in 16:9 format. Use autonomous mode and a clear concept structure.

prompt_templates.title: Turn Notes Into Steps
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these notes into a 45-second vertical how-to explainer for beginners: [notes]. Use concise narration, captions, and three ordered steps.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Brand Styling
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a square explainer from [article]. Use these brand colors and fonts: [tokens]. Present the storyboard for approval before frame production.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Narrated Story
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 75-second narrative explainer from [source]. Preserve [script] verbatim, use [voice], add BGM and SFX, then validate before rendering.

output_examples.input: Explain compound interest to new investors in 60 seconds.
output_examples.output: A six-frame concept explainer with a snowball metaphor, concise narration, timed captions, progressive diagrams, and a final MP4 render.

output_examples.input: Turn these onboarding notes into a vertical how-to video.
output_examples.output: A three-step 9:16 storyboard with branded typography, voiceover cues, animated step markers, background music, captions, and validation results.

output_examples.input: Create a square explainer from this research summary.
output_examples.output: A concise evidence-led storyboard with one key statistic, a layered diagram, source-faithful narration, smooth transitions, and a review-ready preview.

best_practices: Provide a clear audience, message, target length, and destination.
Review the storyboard before frame production when accuracy or brand control matters.
Supply verified facts, pronunciation guidance, and brand assets before audio generation.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for website capture or product promotion.
Do not provide unverified claims and expect the workflow to fact-check them.
Do not skip preview review when visual accuracy or compliance is important.

faq.question: What source material can I provide?
faq.answer: You can provide an article, notes, a topic, a brief, or a narration script.

faq.question: Which video formats are supported?
faq.answer: The workflow supports 16:9 landscape, 1:1 square, and 9:16 portrait formats.

faq.question: Can it use my brand colors and fonts?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide brand tokens, and the frame preset can remix its palette and typography.

faq.question: Does it require a HeyGen account?
faq.answer: HeyGen sign-in enables provider audio features. The workflow can continue with supported local engines when available.

faq.question: Can it preserve my script exactly?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose verbatim mode, and the workflow segments your words without rewriting them.

faq.question: What files does it produce?
faq.answer: It produces a storyboard, script, audio metadata, frame compositions, captions, an assembled preview, and a rendered MP4.
